::: {#exr-standardize}
#### A standardized cholesterol value

In the WCGS data,
cholesterol (`chol`) is measured in mg/dL.

1. Compute the sample mean and sample standard deviation of `chol`.
2. A man has `chol` equal to 250 mg/dL.
   By how many standard deviations does his value differ from the sample mean,
   and in which direction?
3. What are the units of your answer to part 2?
:::
